assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key areas use provisional polygons inferred from announcement text; they must not be treated as official redlines or precise-area bases. All area-sensitive metrics and figures must be regenerated when official polygons are released.
assumptions.impact: All spatial conclusions are directional design suggestions; content scoring remains eligible per submission policy.

assumptions.statement: The heritage-park green spine is modeled as a continuous corridor of about 210 m width (lon 116.3460-116.3485); actual park cross-sections vary and must follow surveyed park boundaries.
assumptions.impact: Green space area and green ratio would change with the real park boundary; formulas are fixed for recalculation.

assumptions.statement: Floors of the 39 catalytic demonstration projects are proposal assumptions (4-24 floors, per-feature floors_proposed); catalyst_total_floor_area_sqm and catalyst_far_index derive from them and are not statutory FAR values.
assumptions.impact: Metrics are design-proposal indices; statutory intensity awaits official regulatory conditions.

assumptions.statement: Y-Era calendar (Y0=1909), Merge Day, Qinglongqiao Dialogue and all naming/branding items are open co-creation proposals; adoption is decided by the organizer.
assumptions.impact: No naming or event claim implies confirmed government arrangement.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenario cards commit to minimal data collection, on-device processing preference and human review; test/validation scenarios require fenced areas, human takeover and regulatory approval before any operation.
assumptions.impact: Scenario deployment depends on privacy, safety and ethics review; none is an approved operation.
